```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(rhinovirus))
```
Rhinovirus data
```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
ggplot(rhinovirus)
```
```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "black") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Percentage") +
  ggtitle("Percentage of positive PCR test results for rhinovirus")
```
